body.purpose: Default for controls, input values, panel rows; buttons at weight 500.

label.purpose: Section intros (uppercase, wide-tracked), accordion triggers, counts.

mono.purpose: Machine-true values only: addresses, ports, duration, counts, rules.

shadows.name: glass-cast
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system: soft cast under glass planes plus inset top sheen. Light theme: 0 12px 40px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.18) + inset sheen 0.8.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: One-shot springs: reveals, chevron, hover/press scales.

motion.name: loop-rule
motion.value: transform/opacity only, CSS or WebGL, paused when unfocused
motion.purpose: All looping animation must be compositor-promoted and honor prefers-reduced-motion (decorative) while status feedback may keep pulsing.

components.name: Connect Disc (hero)
components.description: The single ignition point: 160px frosted-glass circle with the status icon; amber rings flare around it while connecting.
components.html: <button class="ds-hero" aria-label="Connect"><svg class="ds-hero-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2v10"/><path d="M18.4 6.6a9 9 0 1 1-12.77.04"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; cursor: pointer; background: color-mix(in srgb, #1e1e1e 58%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.6); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); outline: none; } .ds-hero::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(242,113,28,0.4); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; } .ds-hero-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; color: #6b7280; } .ds-hero:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-hero:hover .ds-hero-icon { color: #f2711c; } .ds-hero:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-hero:focus-visible::after { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled ember control; hover dims to 80% opacity instead of darkening or shadowing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #f2711c; color: #0d0d0f; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; outline: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(242,113,28,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Void-filled with a hairline border; used for secondary switches and toggles.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: #09090b; color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; outline: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(242,113,28,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only, transparent; hover lifts to muted. Used in the title bar and on pills.
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; outline: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-icon svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: #27272a; color: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-icon:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(242,113,28,0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline-stroked field; focus swaps the stroke for a 3px ember halo.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: transparent; color: #fafafa; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f2711c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(242,113,28,0.25); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Glass Accordion Panel
components.description: Frosted drawer: hairline ring that stiffens when open, spring chevron, separator, slide-in body.
components.html: Control what the tunnel negotiates.
components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #1e1e1e 58%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.6); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); outline: none; } .ds-panel-trigger { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-panel-trigger svg:first-child { width: 13px; height: 13px; color: #f2711c; } .ds-panel-chevron { width: 13px; height: 13px; margin-left: auto; color: rgba(161,161,170,0.7); transform: rotate(180deg); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-panel-trigger:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(242,113,28,0.6); } .ds-panel-divider { height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-panel-body { padding: 10px 12px; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Count Chip
components.description: Translucent pill for history/preset counts; mono, tabular, never colored.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 16px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #a1a1aa; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Live egress/status row: 6px state dot plus mono telemetry; teal = tunnel live.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #1e1e1e 80%, transparent); color: #a1a1aa; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2dd4bf; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(45,212,191,0.6); }

narrative.overview:
Aether-GUI is a dark glass command console in which exactly one element is alive: the ember. The whole lower third of the interface is a frosted-glass instrument panel — hairline rings, mono telemetry, accordion drawers — all quiet, all at rest. The hero connect disc is the sole ignition point: a circular glass lens that, when pressed, flares into amber radar rings (a WebGL shader sweeps three concentric lines outward) while the tunnel is found, then settles into a calm teal glow with a soft check when the way out is open. The palette is warm near-black with one amber accent; the metaphor is a single ember in a dark room, never a floodlight.

The voice is quiet precision for a non-technical user in a hostile network: nothing decorative that isn't functional, nothing that shouts. Every surface is translucent glass (blur + saturation), every panel is hairline-framed, every motion is either a 100-300ms spring or a pure compositor loop. The app must read as an instrument you trust, not a game you play — calm, engineered, and honest about what it is doing at every moment (real elapsed time, real scan percentage, real leak checks).

Density is deliberate: controls are small (32px targets), type is 10-14px, and the status line is the only prose on the idle screen. Because the primary user may be anxious about being watched, the system favors certainty: state changes are announced with color + icon + motion together, never color alone.
keyCharacteristics: One ember: the amber accent is the single ignition/attention color; statuses speak teal/red/gray.
Frosted glass everywhere: blur 22-26px + saturate 1.4-1.6, translucent planes, inset top sheen.
Hairline framing: 1px rgba-white 8-10% borders and rings; radii 6-14px on controls.
Telemetry type: JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals for addresses, counts, and timing.
Compositor-only loops: ambient orbs and radar pulses are transform/opacity CSS or WebGL, paused when the window is unfocused.
Flat by default: depth comes from tonal lightening (surface-1..4) and glass blur, not drop shadows.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: The amber accent never floods a surface — it appears as a dot, a ring, an icon, or a 32px filled control, on well under 10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point: when ember shows, the user reads "here is the one thing that matters."

rules.name: The Status Trio Rule
rules.body: Connecting is amber, connected is teal, error is red, idle is gray. No other hue ever carries state; the accent color picker may change the ember's hue, but connecting/connected/error/idle always stay amber/teal/red/gray.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that reports truth — addresses, durations, attempt counts, percentages — uses tabular-nums in JetBrains Mono. Timers and counts never jitter while they tick.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Hover lifts exactly 1px (translateY(-1px)), presses scale to 0.98, and the glass cast appears only on glass planes. If a surface needs to read higher, lighten the surface token — never add a second shadow.

dos: Do keep the ember rare: one dot, ring, icon, or 32px control at a time; never fill panels with the accent.
Do state transitions with color + icon + motion together — a state change announced by color alone is untrusted.
Do keep every machine-true value in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do use tonal lightening (surface-1..4) before reaching for shadows; the only shadow is the glass cast.
Do keep all looping animation compositor-only (transform/opacity CSS or WebGL) and paused while the window is unfocused.
Do frame panels with 1px hairline rings at 5-10% white; radiate warmth through hairlines, not borders.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue for status — connecting/connected/error/idle is amber/teal/red/gray, always.
Don't color area fills with the accent, add blue-tinted surfaces, or paint borders stronger than 12% white.
Don't add system drop shadows to dark surfaces; depth is tonal and glass, flat by default.
Don't invent large display type; the system's biggest text is 14px, and the hero communicates through motion and light, not words.
Don't drop the window shell's asymmetric base (18px top / 30px bottom) or its inset top highlight.
Don't run loops that don't honor prefers-reduced-motion — decorative breathing must stop; only active status feedback (spinner, rings while connecting) may keep pulsing.
